reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and reorder my usual brand when it runs out, so I don't need a sachet to go. Nothing here is bad, it just solves a problem I don't have.
objection: I take it at home at night, so a travel-ready sachet is not worth switching from what I already reorder.
would_change_my_mind: If it were clearly cheaper per day than what I buy now, or if I started traveling a lot and needed it on the go.
